steps.title: Retrieve and Reprint Aadhaar Card
steps.explanation: Use the UIDAI portal to retrieve a lost Aadhaar number (UID) via OTP sent to the registered mobile/email, then order a PVC card reprint or download an e-Aadhaar.
steps.why_now: Aadhaar authentication via OTP is often required as identity proof to reissue other lost documents like PAN and Driving Licence.
documents: Registered Mobile Number or Email ID
steps.time: Immediate for e-Aadhaar; up to 15 days for PVC delivery

steps.title: Apply for Duplicate PAN Card
steps.explanation: Submit a request for a PAN card reprint online. The PAN number remains the same, but a new physical card is dispatched.
steps.why_now: Required to restore your financial identity and prevent potential misuse. Necessary for banking and tax compliance.
steps.where: Income Tax Department portal / UTIITSL / NSDL

steps.title: Apply for Duplicate Driving Licence
steps.explanation: Log into the Sarathi Parivahan portal, select your state (Kerala), and submit an application for a duplicate DL using your original licence details and an FIR.
steps.why_now: Mandatory legal requirement to continue driving legally. Missing licences carry a risk of identity theft.
steps.where: Ministry of Road Transport and Highways (Sarathi Parivahan)
